The '''Ord Yndar system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Esaga sector/Legends|Esaga sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Yndar]].
